title: Exact discovery, activation fallback, and canonical locators

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Open the demo in Unity with the local bridge running and build mcp-server. Start one fresh stdio MCP session and do not refresh tools/list after activation.

steps.title: Replay exact and filtered discovery
steps.payload: Call capabilities with tool_name=unity_open_mcp_component_modify and inspect the single complete contract. Page a query for component tools in the typed-editor group. Activate the scene tag, deliberately do not refresh tools/list, then use manage_tools action=invoke for gameobject_find and read_compile_errors. Also verify unknown, inactive, recursive, and conflicting-selector refusals.

steps.title: Replay canonical and legacy locator shapes
steps.payload: Inspect Main Camera Transform data with game_object_path, component_type, and property_path. Repeat with each declared unambiguous legacy alias and record deprecation notes. Send unknown or conflicting keys and a nested invalid component patch in a two-step batch; confirm rejection occurs before the first step creates its sentinel object.

steps.title: Expected outcomes
items: Exact lookup returns one bounded full contract; filtered pages are deterministic and availability remains null when it cannot be known.
An activated non-default tool is immediately callable through manage_tools invoke without a tools/list refresh, using normal routing and protections.
Canonical locators resolve, supported aliases are explicit and deprecated, and unknown, conflicting, or nested-invalid keys fail before dispatch.

steps.title: Record the MCP transcript, deprecations, and sentinel check

reset.note: Deactivate only groups activated for this replay if desired. Confirm the sentinel object was never created and do not save scene changes.
